name: Forearm Plank
formCue: Ribs down, squeeze glutes, straight line head to heels

name: Bicycle Crunch
formCue: Slow elbow to opposite knee, low back stays down

name: Dead Bug
formCue: Low back pressed into the floor, move opposite arm and leg

name: Side Plank
formCue: Hips high, stack shoulders over elbow

name: Flutter Kicks
formCue: Small fast kicks, keep lower back down

name: Mountain Climbers
formCue: Hips level, drive knees to chest

name: Hollow Hold
formCue: Lower back glued down, arms and legs long

name: Russian Twist
formCue: Chest tall, rotate from the ribs, not the arms

name: Bird Dog
formCue: Reach long, keep hips square to the floor

name: Reverse Crunch
formCue: Curl the pelvis up, no swinging
